acceptance_checks.evidence: I040 ledger, receipt, and review are pass; the joint I000-I050 regression is green.
Tests read protocol_lock.template.yaml and bind mean, calibrated-logit, reliability, two-layer graph, memory controls, seeds, and the 136-member policy grid.
Mean and trainable calibrated-logit baselines handle partial availability and explicitly abstain with neutral probability when all branches are missing.
Reliability supervision and robust median/IQR quality scaling can fit only on D_e_tr; unavailable inputs are masked without producing non-finite tensors.
The confirmatory graph accepts only unique bidirectional non-self observed_pair edges, audits pair feature names, uses two edge-conditioned layers, and emits edge traces.
The no-graph branch receives no edge tensors and has exactly the same trainable parameter count as full; no-reliability uses availability-only weights.
Memory beta, K, hysteresis, alarm, and abstention values are restricted to the preregistered grid; policy selection reads only D_e_pol and enforces coverage and event constraints.
No-memory requires the corresponding full SHA-256 checkpoint; mask-only priors fit only D_e_tr; temporal and pair-alignment controls use deterministic derangements and locked test strata/seeds.
S1 threshold selection reads only D_b_sel, enforces the locked 0.10-0.90 grid, applies false-alarm feasibility first, and preserves a diagnostic blocked result when infeasible.
Methane event evaluation constructs intervals, matches predictions chronologically one-to-one, counts duplicates and misses, and reports valid hours plus lead-time median and IQR.
Episode evaluation requires episode_id and strictly increasing step_index, prevents cross-episode event/flip merging, breaks prediction events on abstention, and reports explicit counts and coverage.
Tests cover all-missing, all-abstain, no prediction, no truth, prior continuing alarms, repeated alarms, boundary separation, and blocked selection cases.
Fusion feature and edge schemas reject episode, skeleton, group, source-component, pair, pool, label, truth, future, and test provenance shortcuts.
Frozen I050 command passed 7/7, supplementary event tests passed 7/7, compileall passed, and I000-I050 passed 39/39.
Only synthetic arrays, tensors, traces, and edge tables were used; no full dataset extraction, remote connection, or Slurm job occurred.
Accepted receipt has 20 verified input hashes with zero mismatch and SHA-256 c9ce220dfbf94d469f878e729fcc81e873d80109f908d46c48245f2e01ae8dea.

findings: Attempt 1 was retained as a failed test expectation because the fixture had not supplied K consecutive high-memory updates.
Attempt 2 passed its command but was rejected until parameter matching, explicit event diagnostics, locked grids, all-missing behavior, robust scaling, and shortcut controls were executable.
Attempt 3 passed the then-current tests but was rejected after static review found cross-episode boundary leakage and protocol-lock bypasses in edge features, policy values, and mask-only priors.
Attempt 4 retained the expected malformed-stratum assertion mismatch introduced by contract hardening; the corrected fixture now separately tests singleton and malformed strata.
I050 is local synthetic implementation evidence only. It does not assert dataset readiness, trained performance, graph eligibility, or any manuscript result.
